add.title: CHRC says transgender rights are observed in prison
add.summary: Khmer Times (19 Feb 2025) reports Cambodian Human Rights Committee (CHRC) president Keo Remy, speaking at the handover of an ambulance to Correctional Centre 2 at Prey Sar prison in Phnom Penh, said Cambodia observes transgender prisoners' rights: transgender offenders who have undergone sex-change surgery are transferred from Correctional Centre 1 (the men's facility) to Correctional Centre 2 (the women's facility). The statement was made in praise of the centre, not as a published regulation, and no statute or formal policy text is cited; the article also flags that prison overcrowding has worsened because of gang-crackdown arrests. This is the only direct documentation of trans-prisoner placement practice for Cambodia found in two search rounds.
